name: Rule Deck Run
loop: Draft cards that are trading rules (cut a loser at -5%, hold through noise) then watch a masked price path play your deck out; each round adds a rule.
hook: Deck synergies make you think in rules, not hunches.
risk: Rule cards may read as strategy advice; label as game rules only.

name: Rule Deck Calibrated
loop: Pick three rule cards, then slide a probability on each upcoming bar; the deck's rules fire automatically and your honesty multiplies their payoff.
risk: Complexity; two scores may confuse.

name: Pocket Draft Duel
loop: Two players alternately draft from a shared pool of masked chart snippets, then each predicts their own picks; higher combined score wins.
hook: Drafting adds a bluffing layer on top of prediction.
risk: Async fairness; collusion in challenge links.

name: One Thumb Rhythm
loop: A pulsing beat marks each candle; tap on the beat to lean up, hold through the beat to stay, and release to lock paper gains.
hook: Rhythm feel makes timing visceral and quick.
risk: Fast loops can drive compulsive replays.

name: Metronome Calls
loop: A metronome ticks every four seconds; set a probability slider before each tick for the next move and see Brier fall as the tempo rises.
hook: Pure tempo-trained calibration in a minute.
risk: Time pressure can encourage careless guessing.

name: Audio Only Tape
loop: Price is sonified as a rising or falling tone; listeners tap up or down on what the next tone will do, no visuals at all.
hook: Fully accessible to blind and low-vision users.
risk: Synthetic only; sonification may mislead on scale.

name: Screenless Hunch
loop: Voice or single tap each morning: will the market-wide close be higher by evening; a spoken result arrives at close.
hook: Zero-UI daily ritual that fits any ability.
risk: Streaks may induce daily compulsion; cap multipliers.

name: Big Button Mode
loop: One huge button pair, high contrast, no timers; each masked chart asks up or down, and a calm reveal explains the move in plain words.
risk: Low depth may bore; keep as a mode, not a game.

name: Slow Garden
loop: Plant paper positions as seeds in a garden; weather is the synthetic market, diversified plots survive storms, and growth is risk-adjusted return.
hook: Gentle idle loop teaches diversification visually.
risk: Cute framing may trivialize losses; show drawdown honestly.

name: Idle Paper Fund
loop: Set a paper allocation once a week; it idles against delayed live prices and you only return to rebalance for a minute.
risk: Idle checking habit; no push nags allowed.

name: Co-op Lighthouse
loop: Two to four friends share one paper fund keeping a lighthouse lit; each controls a sector slider and any one blow-up dims the light for all.
hook: Cooperative stakes make risk discipline social.
risk: Pressure on weakest member; allow anonymous roles.

name: Crew Forecast
loop: A crew of friends each submit a probability; the crew score is the Brier of the averaged forecast, so diversity of opinion beats groupthink.
hook: Teaches wisdom of crowds with friends.
risk: Social pressure to conform; hide others until lock.

name: Reverse Reveal
loop: You see the aftermath first; pick which of three event descriptions plausibly came before it, then learn what truly happened.
hook: Backwards puzzle flips the usual guessing frame.
risk: Hindsight bias reinforcement; stress it in the reveal.

name: Chart Jigsaw
loop: Four shuffled chart segments from one masked history must be dragged into true time order using only volatility and trend clues.
hook: Spatial puzzle with a shareable grid result.
risk: No prediction skill trained; clarify it is pattern play.

name: Cone Weaver
loop: Drag a cone around where the path will be in ten bars; hit 80 percent of your 80 percent ranges to win and widen when unsure.
risk: Range games are dry; need clear feedback visuals.

name: Fog of Candles
loop: Hold to ride a path through fog that reveals only a few candles ahead; relics offered between rounds change how far you see.
hook: Fog makes each decision feel like a dungeon step.
risk: Relic buffs could imply edge; keep them cosmetic or rule-only.

name: Boss Volatility
loop: Three rounds of calm then a volatility boss; survive by sizing paper positions, with boss patterns drawn from historical shock shapes.
hook: A clear climax teaches sizing under stress.
risk: Shocks could feel like casino spikes; keep odds fair.

name: Relic Shop Run
loop: Between rounds pick one of three relics, e.g. 'wider cone' or 'second look', that bend scoring rules; no relic touches real data.
hook: Build variety makes each run unique.
risk: Energy limit must not nudge payment; no purchases.

name: Ghost Of Yesterday
loop: Race a ghost replaying your own earlier forecasts on the same chart; beat your past self by being better calibrated.
hook: Competing with yourself avoids toxic ranking.
risk: Ghost data storage and retention privacy.

name: Rival Ghost Replay
loop: Play a masked chart against a recorded ghost of another player's anonymous choices; you see their ghost only after you lock.
risk: Ghost anonymity must hold; no identity inference.

name: Verified Echo
loop: Swipe whether an anonymised verified trader closed a position in profit, shown only entry context; reveal teaches how often outcomes surprise.
hook: Ties the game to the app's real verified records.
risk: Re-identification of traders; strict anonymisation required.

name: Trader Mirror
loop: Estimate the win probability of an anonymous verified trade from its holding period and size band; your Brier shows how well you read records.
hook: Trains healthy skepticism of track records.
risk: Could seem to rate real people; blur all details.

name: Track Record Detective
loop: Three anonymous summaries; spot which one has a record too short or too lucky to trust, learning confidence intervals along the way.
risk: Judgments may be read as endorsing a trader.

name: Survive The Drawdown
loop: Start with a paper stake and a long bear-market masked path; each tap trims exposure, and survival is staying above a floor to the end.
hook: Survival not profit is a refreshing goal.
risk: Bear framing may stoke fear; show recovery too.

name: Last Candle Standing
loop: Many players hold the same synthetic path; whoever lets go too early or too late is eliminated each wave, until one remains.
risk: Elimination shame; keep identities as avatars.

name: Calm Sprint
loop: Five ultra-short synthetic charts, one tap each, ending with a soft summary and no streak counters.
risk: Low stickiness is the point; may lack retention.

name: Dark Pattern Free
loop: A short branching story of a paper trader; each choice is a forecast with a probability, and the story reflects calibration, not profit.
hook: Narrative framing sticks without gambling cues.
risk: Story realism could imply advice; fictional chars only.

name: Market Detective Story
loop: Weekly mystery: clues from masked news snippets and charts point to which of four sectors moved; solve the case in chapters.
hook: Episodic mystery retains without daily pressure.
risk: News snippets may be copyrighted; write originals.

name: Time Capsule Bet
loop: Seal a probability about a market level a month from now in a capsule; capsules open together and score all at once.
hook: Long horizon rewards patience over frequency.
risk: Delayed feedback may reduce engagement.

name: Haiku Of Price
loop: Paint a three-line shape forecast of a path, then watch it overlay the real one; the share card is an artful comparison, not a score.
risk: No scoring feedback may weaken learning.

name: Sixty Second Sage
loop: Log-score blitz: ten masked charts in one minute, where overconfident wrong answers cost heavily and fifty-fifty hedges are safe.
hook: Harsh log scoring creates memorable lessons.
risk: Log loss is opaque; needs plain-language explanation.

name: Odds Auction
loop: Two players each name a probability; the one whose number is more extreme must stand behind it, and an honest middle wins ties.
hook: Bluffing and honesty mix in a duel.
risk: Resembles betting; no stakes, just points.

name: Pair Trade Puzzle
loop: Two masked paths appear; swipe toward the one that outperformed the other over the window, a daily relative-strength puzzle.
hook: Relative framing is simple and elegant.
risk: Pair games could suggest strategies; keep neutral.

name: Odd One Out
loop: Four charts, one from a different regime; spot the odd one in seconds and learn what separates calm from chaotic markets.
hook: Quick pattern recognition with a daily share grid.
risk: Hindsight bias; avoid claiming it predicts anything.

name: Regime Radio
loop: Hear or see a clip and label the regime, trending, choppy or crashing; a codex fills in with each regime you correctly learn.
risk: Labels become pseudo-signals; keep in education mode.

name: Weather Report Game
loop: Forecast the chance of a large market move tomorrow like a weather forecaster, scored over a season against friends.
risk: Daily cadence habit; offer weekly option.

name: Shadow Portfolio
loop: Mirror a pre-set theme basket using sliders; each week the delayed market scores your Sharpe-like ratio against friends.
hook: Slow league loop with sizing focus.
risk: Theme names risk trademark; use generic themes.

name: Risk Budget Tetris
loop: Fit falling risk blocks into a fixed budget grid; clear rows by balancing exposure, and the final shape is scored for diversification.
hook: Puzzle hybrid makes risk budgeting tangible.
risk: Abstract link to trading may be lost.

name: Spot The Lucky
loop: Swipe 'skill' or 'luck' on anonymous verified summaries; the reveal shows simulated random streaks of the same length.
hook: Teaches how common lucky streaks are.
risk: Might disparage real traders; use only anonymous aggregates.

name: Spectator Predict
loop: Watch a live-delayed market segment alongside other viewers, tapping a prediction before each reveal bar and seeing the crowd split.
risk: Herding behaviour; reveal crowd only after lock.

name: Campfire Forecast
loop: A scheduled shared session where a host walks through a synthetic path and everyone sets probabilities at each pause.
risk: Host moderation; needs rules for chat.

name: Lantern Walk
loop: Walk a path carrying a lantern whose brightness is your paper capital; steady holds keep it bright, panic and over-trading dim it.
risk: Metaphor may hide real loss magnitude.

name: Churn Tax Run
loop: Every extra trade costs a rising paper fee that carries across floors; the deepest floor wins, discouraging overtrading.
risk: Fee math may confuse; needs plain tooltips.

name: Patience Meter Game
loop: A patience meter grows while you hold and bursts bonus points if the trend plays out; fidgeting resets it to zero.
hook: Rewards waiting, the opposite of slot-like tapping.
risk: Could encourage holding losers; show drawdown.

name: Tiny Quant Lab
loop: Assemble a simple rule from blocks (if X then Y) and test it on masked history; the lab shows how often it fails out of sample.
risk: Rules could be read as strategies; label as toy.

name: Overfit Trap
loop: Given a rule that perfectly fits past random data, predict whether it will work on the next segment, and learn from the near-certain fail.
risk: Perceived cynicism may discourage learners.

name: Calibration Cards
loop: Each card is a confidence band like 60-70 percent; place cards onto forecasts, and cards upgrade only when their bucket's hit rate matches.
risk: Card rarity could mimic loot boxes; no randomness.

name: Joker Rule Wildcards
loop: Collect wildcard rules that bend one constraint, e.g. no exits for two bars but double paper gains; pick carefully as risk grows.
risk: Double-gain wildcards glamourise risk.

name: Morning Pages
loop: Journaling game: write a one-line reason before each forecast, and the end screen groups your reasons by calibration to reveal which work.
risk: Free text may contain personal data or advice.

name: Reason Tags
loop: Choose a tag, momentum or mean-reversion or neutral, then a probability; stats later show which reasoning style you were calibrated with.
risk: Tags might be treated as signals.

name: Pace Car
loop: Follow a pace-car ghost of a steady low-risk allocation; stay near it to avoid penalty and deviate only with a clear conviction budget.
risk: Ghost may seem a recommended allocation.

name: Pit Stop Rebalance
loop: Race laps of synthetic market; you get three pit stops to rebalance, each costs time, so plan them before the lap starts.
hook: Racing frame creates tension for rebalancing.
risk: Energy gating must not become pay-to-play.

name: Siege Of Volatility
loop: Defend a castle of paper capital against waves of shocks by shifting walls (allocations) between hedges and growth between waves.
risk: Warlike framing; fine for adults but keep tone neutral.

name: Seasonal Garden League
loop: Eight-week season of weekly forecasts; leagues promote on calibration, not profit, and your garden grows with consistent weeks.
risk: Leaderboard pressure in small groups.

name: Dueling Cones
loop: Both players drag ranges for the same path; the narrower correct range wins the round, a wrong one loses it, forcing honest width.
hook: Squeezes ego out of range choice.
risk: Narrowing incentive may encourage gambling on tight bands.

name: Whisper Network
loop: Observe anonymous verified record summaries in a feed and swipe your read; consensus markers appear only after you commit.
hook: Learning from records without copying anyone.
risk: Copy-trading drift; no identifiers or tickers.

name: Bluff Or Believe
loop: A friend sends a chart plus a claimed probability; you swipe believe or bluff on whether it is honest, scored vs their true calibration.
risk: Accusation tone between friends.

name: Echo Chamber Escape
loop: A feed of confident opinions sways your slider; you score better by discounting them, and the reveal shows how much they moved you.
risk: Fictional opinions must not imitate real voices.

name: Narrator Mode
loop: A narrator describes a fictional market town; your taps steer fictional merchants' paper decisions, and outcomes follow synthetic prices.
risk: Fiction may be mistaken for realistic expectations.

name: Boss Rush Daily
loop: A once-a-day seeded run of five masked boss charts; everyone gets the same seed, shares a pip grid, and tomorrow brings a new seed.
hook: Shared seed gives conversation, not compulsion.
risk: Share card may overclaim skill; add disclaimer.

name: Seeded Gauntlet
loop: Send a seeded gauntlet to a friend by link; both play identical masked rounds and compare per-round calibration afterwards.
hook: Easy viral challenge without accounts to browse.
risk: Link sharing and invite spam.

name: Stat Pet
loop: A small creature grows healthier as your forecasts become better calibrated, and its mood shows overconfidence as a puffed chest.
hook: Affection loop tied to honest forecasting.
risk: Guilt mechanics on neglect; no sadness penalties.

name: Flip Book History
loop: Flip through ten masked historic episodes, swiping 'rally' or 'slump' for what followed; the codex then names the real episode.
hook: Codex learns market history through play.
risk: Naming real events accuracy; use only factual data.

name: Silent Auction Odds
loop: Ten rapid forecasts where the leaderboard shows only your calibration decile, never raw returns.
risk: Percentile ranking can still promote gambling feel.

name: Dual Thumb Hedge
loop: Left thumb holds long exposure, right thumb holds a hedge; release either at will while the path moves, and net exposure is scored.
risk: Accessibility: requires two hands; offer alternative.

name: Tide Table
loop: Read a weekly tide table of expected volatility, then forecast whether next week's swing is above or below tide; scored like a harbour master.
risk: Volatility forecasts may be mistaken for timing tools.

name: Heartbeat Hold
loop: Rest a thumb on the screen and feel haptic heartbeats rise with drawdown; lift when it feels too much and see if calm would have paid.
risk: Haptics may stress users; offer opt-out.

name: Braille Ticker
loop: Haptic and screen-reader-first sequence of ticks; no sight needed, with spoken explanation after each reveal.
hook: Built for blind users first, enjoyed by all.
risk: Needs real screen-reader testing before launch.

name: Colour Blind Safe Bars
loop: Charts use shape and texture instead of colour, and sliders have numeric steppers so no gesture is required to play.
hook: Accessible by default, not by option.
risk: Design polish cost; none beyond effort.

name: Dojo Of Doubt
loop: Belts are earned by reaching calibration thresholds over many forecasts, not by returns; a sensei line names your bias.
risk: Belt grind might over-extend sessions.

name: Grandmaster Study
loop: Deep-study mode: one chart, five minutes, forecast then annotate what you ignored; the codex stores your annotated mistakes.
risk: Low volume; energy cap wording must be kind.

name: Dice Free Casino
loop: A deliberately dull anti-casino: coin flips on synthetic paths that teach that streaks occur in pure noise and nothing is predictable.
risk: Boredom; but it also protects against false skill.

name: Random Walk Truth
loop: Three charts: which was real and which random? Most players score near chance, and the share card says so.
risk: Players may feel tricked; keep tone light.

name: Fake Or Real Chart
loop: Swipe 'real history' or 'synthetic' for single charts, with a labelled synthetic pool always declared as such after the swipe.
risk: Labelled-synthetic rule must stay visible post-reveal.

name: Market Whisper Chain
loop: Telephone game: each viewer sees the previous viewer's hint then adds their own; the chain's final call is scored for all.
hook: Hilarious drift shows noise in groupthink.
risk: Message content moderation.

name: Tarot Free Oracle
loop: Draw a symbolic card that frames a question (not a prediction); choose a probability and read a calm interpretation about uncertainty.
risk: Superstition framing; explicit 'not a forecast'.

name: Cartographer
loop: Draw maps of past volatility zones on masked paths, filling a codex atlas; the atlas scores how well your zones contained later moves.
risk: Atlas may imply support/resistance advice.

name: Escape Room Ledger
loop: A themed room puzzle whose locks open by correctly reading drawdown, win rate and sample size from three anonymous record cards.
risk: Anonymous cards must not match real traders.

name: Sample Size Smash
loop: Given a trader's anonymous win count and sample size, draw a confidence range for their true skill; narrow with more trades.
risk: Shown stats are aggregate only; avoid ranking people.

name: Wheel Of Humility
loop: Each round a spin picks a modifier that hurts you in a visible, fair way, such as hidden candles, to teach acting on partial information.
risk: Spin resembles gambling visuals; use choose-one instead.

name: Time Loop Trader
loop: Replay the same masked month over and over; each loop you remember patterns, but the reveal comes only at the end of loop three.
risk: Memorising a masked path could overfit; vary seeds.

name: Gladiator Calibration
loop: Head-to-head forecasts of the same synthetic bars; the better Brier takes the round, best of five, tracked as a rating.
risk: Rating anxiety; hide until placement games end.

name: Daily Crossword Ledger
loop: A mini crossword whose clues are generic market concepts, rewarding vocabulary that unlocks the next day's forecasting puzzle.
hook: Word-puzzle crowd gets in through language.
risk: Offers little prediction training.

name: Rank The Charts
loop: Drag five masked paths into order of eventual return over a hidden window; score by rank correlation, reveal with a tidy ladder.
hook: Sort puzzle is easy to grasp.
risk: Might read as stock picking if tickers revealed.

name: Fund Manager Tycoon
loop: Run a toy fund across ten years in five minutes: clients fear drawdown, so keep their trust meter high more than return high.
risk: Tycoon cash visuals could glamorise wealth.

name: Client Panic Sim
loop: Fictional clients call in during a storm; choose how to respond and see how communication changes their behaviour.
hook: Soft skills in a market game.
risk: Fictional clients only; no personal data.

name: Alarm Clock Gambit
loop: Set tomorrow's call as your alarm; waking you with the result and a gentle lesson about luck.
hook: Ritual hook with minimal screen time.
risk: Streak multipliers drive daily compulsion; cap.

name: Tug Of War Teams
loop: Bullish and bearish teams pull a rope with every correct call; the rope position reflects crowd accuracy not crowd opinion.
risk: Tribal framing may harden views.

name: Quiet Library
loop: Browse named past market episodes like a library, answering reflective questions; no clock, no score, only a growing codex.
risk: Named episodes need factual accuracy and no vendor names.

name: Cooperative Chart Reading
loop: Two players see complementary halves of a masked chart and must agree on a call by talking, scored together.
risk: Voice chat moderation.

name: Predict The Reaction
loop: Read a generic fictional announcement, swipe how a similar past stock reacted that day; the reveal teaches expectations versus surprise.
risk: Fictional text only; avoid real company news.

name: Mood Ring Market
loop: A glanceable ring turns calm to stormy with delayed market breadth; guess the colour tomorrow and collect a colour diary.
risk: Colour readings might imply direction.

name: Speedrun Mode
loop: A best-time speedrun through twelve synthetic bars for a target paper gain, with splits against your personal-best ghost.
risk: Speed pressure encourages impulsivity.

name: Roguelite Seasons
loop: Weekly run with a theme modifier and a season ladder; at season end all progress resets except codex entries.
hook: Resets keep things fresh and fair.
risk: Reset fatigue; ensure no sunk-cost trap.

name: Anti-Streak Streak
loop: A streak counter that rewards consecutive well-calibrated days, not wins, and quietly forgives one miss per week.
hook: Streak hook aligned with healthy behaviour.
risk: Streaks remain a compulsion lever.

name: Teach The Newbie
loop: Experienced players write a one-line hint for a newcomer's chart; hint authors score on how much the newcomer's calibration improved.
risk: Hints could become advice; moderate for neutrality.

name: Blindfold Chess Charts
loop: The chart is hidden after the first few bars; you hold to stay in the path from memory of its feel, then see how well you felt it.
risk: Gimmicky; low skill transfer.

name: Open Field Day
loop: Annual field day: ten mini-events across forecasting, ranges and sizing, with team points and friendly medals.
hook: Variety event feels like a festival.
risk: Medals might get misused in marketing claims.

name: Pocket Almanac
loop: Flip an almanac page, answer one seasonal-pattern question with honest odds, and learn which folk patterns were noise.
risk: Patterns could be mistaken for tips.

name: Lullaby Mode
loop: A bedtime-friendly one-minute forecast with dim palette, no streaks and no leaderboard, ending with a sleep-friendly goodnight.
risk: Low retention by design; business trade-off.
